name: Josh L
story: I'd been fishing the same stretch of the lake for three years without much luck, so when my line went tight that Saturday morning I figured it was just another snag on a submerged log. Then the "log" pulled back. For ten minutes it felt like the bass had strategy — running for the reeds, diving under the boat, going dead still just to catch me off guard. When I finally got it in the net, my hands were shaking too hard to hold my phone steady for a photo. Eight pounds, easily the biggest fish I've ever caught. I let it go after a few pictures, but I've been smiling about it for a week.
